caption: The drawing displays two adjacent rectangular panels, each containing a distinct floral pattern on a beige background. The panel on the left features a design made up of green leafy stems and clusters of light purple flowers entwined with curling golden-yellow ribbons. The arrangement includes transparent white vertical stripes, suggesting a layered look, and additional curling ribbons in the same yellow color, interspersed throughout the foliage. The panel on the right is characterized by a vertically oriented repetitive pattern: at the center, a zigzagged white stripe runs vertically, bordered by green and beige bands. Down the middle of this stripe, hanging orange-red bell-shaped flowers and green leaves are arranged on thin stems. The rest of the background consists of soft horizontal beige and lavender stripes that alternate subtly, and the vertical green borders are decorated with small white motifs along the edges of the panel. The entire composition is framed by a large cream-colored margin, on which a handwritten note appears in the lower left corner, and a simple linear scale is present in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Paper
